name: Temple Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the east and west. Off to the
desc3: west, you can see the shining shape of the Temple. Even from afar it
desc4: seems to radiate peace and hope. To the north, a fresh stone wall has
desc5: been built, blocking access to what once lay beyond, and Temple Street
desc6: continues to the east and west.
